documents.text:
The Harvgivo notation.

Every map in the Harvgivo notation sends each token of one kind to a token of the next kind. When maps are applied in sequence, the token produced by one map is the token given to the next map.

The Pyrtarn map.

Tokens in the Pyrtarn map are sent according to the following list.

The Pyrtarn map sends qenxil to ondafex.
The Pyrtarn map sends lumka to tuplo.
The Pyrtarn map sends harvpyr to eskfex.
The Pyrtarn map sends ondaka to eskwren.
The Pyrtarn map sends naklum to braplo.
The Pyrtarn map sends givobra to xilka.

The Tuwren map.

Tokens in the Tuwren map are sent according to the following list.

The Tuwren map sends xilka to ovitu.
The Tuwren map sends braplo to oviyuk.
The Tuwren map sends ondafex to eskrusk.
The Tuwren map sends tuplo to drimel.
The Tuwren map sends eskwren to nakesk.
The Tuwren map sends eskfex to tezzel.
